findings.message: The comment says `experimental.agentUpgrade: "security"` records that this upgrade was run by an agent. It doesn't. In Next 16.4.6 the option sets the nudge policy: dev and build tell coding agents about security upgrades (`lib/upgrade/nudge.js`, `server/lib/router-server.js`, `build/index.js`). "security" is also the default (`server/config-shared.js:161`), so this line changes nothing. Fix it one of two ways: drop the key, or keep it and rewrite the comment to say it pins the agent-upgrade nudge policy to security releases. The current text would mislead whoever next edits this config.
findings.scenario: Delete `agentUpgrade: "security"` and run next dev or next build. The nudge behaves exactly the same because the default is already "security". The comment's claim that the line records an agent-run upgrade is false.
